name: PostgreSQL to Email
steps:
1.  Create a data model and specify the [data warehouse](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/destinations/index.html) from which you want the data for your Email. If you have not yet added a data warehouse, go to [data warehouse](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/destinations/index.html#_datachannel_managed_warehouse) tab and add a warehouse.
2.  Authorise DataChannel to connect to your Email.
3.  Click on **\+ Data Sync** to start adding data syncs to your account.

![email reverseetl](/images/cms/reverse-etl-destinations/email-reverseetl-c09f21.png)

     4. Details of individual syncs are available [here](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/reverse_etl/destinations_retl/email/syncs.html).
